text:
Marta L: Hey team — spinning up a bring-up for nova-12b.gguf on hosted. Proposal: gguf-int8 baseline, fp8 sensitivity sweep, then a small hybrid (attn fp8, rest int8). Need smoke plan + priority.
Liam: sg. what's our latency/cost SLO for hosted path?
Marta L: Target p50 ~80ms, p99 <250ms (bs=1). Cost target: aim for ~60% of fp32 token cost if quality OK.
Sophia: I like that sequence. Suggest probes: (1) static int8 calib on 10k lines, (2) fp8 per-layer sensitivity on 1k samples, (3) hybrid per-layer override runs with A/B eval vs fp32.
Marta L: quick checklist:
• dataset: "nova-smoke-1k.jsonl" (diverse prompts)
• metrics: ppl, rouge-l, embedding-sim, exact-match for code prompts
• stop condition: embedding-sim drop >1% or ppl delta >1.5 => abort
Liam: add latency/cost snapshot (tokens/sec, wallet delta) to stop condition.
Marta L: probe command I'll run:
```
./tools/quant_probe.sh \
  --model models/nova-12b.gguf \
  --modes int8,fp8,hybrid \
  --calib-corpus data/nova-smoke-1k.jsonl \
  --out /tmp/quant_probe/2265432100 \
  --metrics ppl,embed_sim,latency
```
Sophia: for hybrid runs try per-layer override syntax:
`--perlayer-override attn:fp8,ffn:int8`
Liam: callouts: watch for tokenization edgecases with the gguf frontend (seen subtle truncation before). Also check KV cache correctness in hybrid mode.
Eval-bot: :robot_face: preliminary results (small run): int8 -> ppl +0.95, embed-sim -0.6%, fp8 -> ppl +0.18, embed-sim -0.1%. Latency: int8 +10% faster vs fp32, fp8 +4%.
Marta L: OK those are promising. int8 has small quality drop, fp8 almost neutral. Hybrid could hit cost sweet spot.
Josh: I'll reserve 2xA100s on the dedicated queue and kick off the 3-day smoke tomorrow. Scheduling job id will be here once queued.
Sophia: also run a targeted hallucination check for instruction prompts (20 seeds). If hallucination increases >0.5% we fail.
Liam: note to self: include reranking fallback plan in routing if model falls below threshold in production.
Marta L: Decision: priority = high; run 72h smoke with checkpoints at 6h, 24h, 48h. Abort criteria = embedding-sim drop >1% OR hallucination increase >0.5 OR ppl delta >1.5. @Josh please tag results.
Josh: queued and scheduled. job start ts 2265432160. Will post logs + link when live. :thumbsup:
Marta L: thanks — will prepare rollout playbook and ops runbook (canary + fallback to nova-12b-fp32).
